title: Add new card
description: An empty, dashed tile for adding a new item to a grid. Its plus icon turns when you hover over it.
pageTitle: "Add New" Placeholder Card for Grids | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it as the last tile in a grid of projects, boards, team members or files, inviting people to create a new item right where it will appear. It also works as an empty state when the grid has nothing in it yet. The rotating plus icon adds a friendly cue on hover.
whenToUse.alt: Animated add new card tile: dashed card with a plus icon that turns on hover

accessibility: The whole tile is one native button, named by its visible text "Add new card".
The icon is decorative and hidden from screen readers.
Keyboard users get a visible focus ring.

fragments.title: The tile
fragments.note: The plus turns wherever the pointer enters the tile.

fragments.title: Resting and hovered
fragments.note: Five custom properties set twice. The icon colour is one of them.
